why: RJ-X74, pending FR-8 (suiteui/frame-rates): a composition can't be 29.97 fps and the catalog has no composition.set-frame-rate until FR-8, so platforms is [] and the harness skips the job on both. From a blank project, by commands: a new 29.97 fps, 10 s composition, a text layer whose x is keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 600 at frame 299, then a PNG sequence render. The trap: the composition silently runs at 30, so frame 299 is timed at 9.967 s, not 9.977 s, and the key lands a frame early on an editor timeline. The assertion: the saved project keeps the rate as 30000/1001 with 300 frames and both keys; the sequence has 300 files and the render times frame 299 at 299 x 1001 / 30000 s within 1 microsecond (HaloFrameRateTests); the readout at frame 1800 of a 2 min copy is 00:01:00;02. The turn-on sets platforms to linux and macos and fixes the expected JSON to FR-8's file shape.
